params.body:
The daily worklist mail and the transport worklist counted every transport that was not `paid`, `cancelled` or `price_requested` as waiting for the garage. That rule (R P1-2.8) is older than the planning states, so `transport_requested`, `pickup_confirmed` and `completed` slipped in: a garage with one delivered transport read "1 transport dat op je wacht" in every mail, and the link opened an overview that said there was nothing to do.

## Change

- `Transport::WAITING_FOR_GARAGE_STATES`: `pending`, `price_available`, `price_received`, `waiting_payment`. These are the states the transport overview already folds under "wait for the garage". Everything after is the office's work.
- `Dealer::OpenTransport` (the mail's count), `WidgetService::get5Data` (the transport worklist) and `TransportOverview::SECTIONS['wait']` all read that one constant, so the mail, the worklist and the overview cannot drift apart again.
- R P1-2.8 now says what is counted and why, and when it changed.

A garage that only has open transports still gets no mail. That is the documented rule in R P1-2.12 and is not changed here.

## Tests

`WorklistMailTest::test_only_a_transport_waiting_for_the_garage_counts`: a garage with a transport in each of the six states after its turn gets a mail with only its lead, and each of the four waiting states counts. The test fails on `main` (the transport line is there) and passes with this change. Worklist mail and worklist page tests pass, plus the full suite.

Closes #1076

params.title: Count only transports that wait for the garage in the daily mail and worklist
